title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：reference　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reference 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the painter ① made the reference that no visitor in the studio would have measured, and he said the making was the whole of the season. The ② reference, meaning the note itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a reference, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ reference in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ reference at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A reference, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the painter said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the reference was the whole of the matter, meaning the authority and not the note. The ⑥ reference, meaning the authority and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; reference, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a note and an authority. He said the authority is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ reference had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ reference of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of measuring; reference, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ reference I remember is the note measured in the catalogue, which closed in 1982 and is still measured as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ reference, my mother said in 1984, is the only note that improves by being measured; every reference, she said, is an authority that has agreed to look like a note. She said the authority was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 参考；提及（指画室里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 参考；提及（指那处参考本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the reference 提到这一处参考
D. n. 参考；提及（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 参考之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的参考之事）
F. n. 参考；提及（指展品目录里写到、被测量的那一处）
G. n. 参考、依据（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 依据（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the reference that no visitor in the studio would have measured
The reference, meaning the note itself and not the brush
the reference at the far easel
the reference was the whole of the matter
the reference had become a line in a catalogue
The reference of the whole thing
A reference, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: make the reference 意为“提到这一处参考”，1975 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯测量的一处参考做了一遍。
reference 意为“参考；提及”，指那处参考本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被测量。
reference 意为“参考；提及”，指画室里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
reference 意为“参考；提及”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
reference 意为“参考、依据”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处依据就是那件事的全部。
reference 意为“依据”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处参考，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
reference 意为“参考；提及”，指展品目录里写到、被测量的那一处，到 1980 年这一处成了展品目录里的一行。
reference 意为“参考之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的参考之事是一处画室和三个季度的测量。
reference 意为“参考；提及”，我记得的是展品目录里测量过的那一处，1982 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一处。
reference 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，参考是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的参考。
